label: Timeline Documentary
description: Production package for deterministic chronology scenes with a dated spine, original archival framing, explicit source labels, and honest missing-image handling.
avoidFor: live dashboards that depend on current metrics

renderCost.notes: The renderer composes three to eight dated events, source labels, archival treatments, and deterministic missing-image placeholders.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduced mode shortens event travel; static mode presents the complete dated spine without animated displacement.

accessibility.notes: High-contrast serif headlines, sans-serif body copy, bounded text fitting, and persistent source labels support documentary reading.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when narration depends on chronological evidence, named dates, source attribution, and a defensible historical conclusion.
hardBlocks: more than eight events without editorial reduction

sourcePolicy.notes: All review visuals are original CSS compositions or deliberate placeholders. No third-party photograph, logo, font binary, or brand identity is registered.

knownLimitations: Shared registry and app-root availability remain outside this ownership slice.
Review imagery uses original archival abstractions instead of third-party historical photographs.
